title: Watch request
description: The watches the core compiles from the user's triggers for one project, handed to the module at start and whenever a trigger changes. A watch request replaces the module's whole set of watches for the project: a watch it does not carry is gone, and an empty list means the module reports nothing for the project. A watch request has no answer document.

project.description: The project the watches are for, so the module resolves the project's settings and credential profile.

watches.description: Every watch the project's triggers compile to. The module reports an event when it matches any one of them.

watch.description: One event kind plus equality filters. An event matches when it is of the kind and every filter's field holds exactly the filter's value.

kind.description: The event kind, prefixed by the module's name and a slash, as describe lists it.

filters.description: The equality filters, at most one per field, each on a field describe declares watchable for the kind.

field.description: The name of the event's field.

value.description: The value the field must equal exactly.
